parsed.explanation: Combined federal-state regime imposes universal birth-sex exposure at borders, passports and government facilities, with documented custody harm if detained, but no credible execution or routine imprisonment for presence and functioning courts that have enjoined some measures. Facility exclusion and document mismatch are inescapable for an outed visitor, while remedies are slow, partial and do not undo the passport or bathroom restrictions already upheld. Minors face added school, sports and care bans in this state.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary sex definition; X/mismatched passports stopped, reports of confiscation/stranding; Feb 2025 cable: document discrepancy casts doubt, refuse and seek evidence, wilful misrepresentation may support permanent fraud ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, not automatic, limited waivers; civil-liberties suit pending, several orders enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch at entry can escalate to refusal, investigation and immigration custody, where birth-sex placement and abuse are documented.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Federal prison policy from 2026: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse. State debate raised solitary for incarcerated trans people under facilities law.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No visitor-specific custody protocol documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Bathroom trespass, document fraud allegation or immigration detention can move visitor into birth-sex custody with documented harm; no operative immunity documented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federally funded single-sex facilities barred by birth sex; this state 2025 law bars bathrooms/locker rooms/changing areas matching identity in public schools, colleges and state-owned buildings, incl. off-campus activities, effective 1 July 2025.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Reasonable-accommodation clause mentioned but method unspecified; exemptions for emergencies/assistance in the cited trespass model, not shown to create general visitor access.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal and state bans combine: even where private settings are not banned, schools, colleges, capitols and other government buildings enforce birth-sex access.

care_services.exposure: National orders target gender-affirming care for minors and investigation of schools/teachers facilitating social transition; state bans care under 18, with reduction of existing treatment. Hormone denial in federal custody documented.
care_services.protection: Not documented for adult visitors seeking continuity; emergency care access for visitors not documented.
care_services.interaction: Minor travelling with guardian faces denied care and school-facility exclusion; adult in custody faces hormone removal.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order redefines sex at birth, removes gender-ideology materials, military ban, trans-athlete entry ban, counterterrorism language including 'radically pro-transgender' groups; 66% poll support for birth-sex documents. State ranked among worst for anti-trans adult legislation (advocacy rubric).
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 2020 employment ruling; courts have blocked/enjoined several orders.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State-threat framing is operationalised through passport, facility and custody rules, not only rhetoric; efficient enforcement increases exposure.

minors_guardians.exposure: State school bathrooms, locker rooms, sports restrictions since 2021/2022, care ban under 18, national directive to criminally investigate teachers using preferred names/pronouns. No state anti-discrimination protection.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented for visiting minors; parental consent routes not documented as mitigation.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor encounters school/college facilities, sports and care exclusion together.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state hate-crime coverage for gender identity; only national backstop. No documented pattern of street violence against visitors in dossier; airport screening described as invasive/outing risk.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime prosecution possible; local municipal ordinances patchy, not state-wide.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police called for facility or document issues are enforcers of birth-sex rules, limiting expectation of protection in those encounters.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit and challenges to executive orders unresolved; SCOTUS allowed passport restrictions to take effect Nov 2025. Difference between federal injunctions in force at travel time uncertain.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have enjoined some orders, legal-aid FAQ exists, 2024 settlement/apology and $300,000 in one health-contract case shows some recourse for organisations.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies do not document operative pre-emption of federal entry/facility/custody exposure by state protections.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine detention/questioning, fines or exclusion, courts deferring in practice, deterrence without execution. Higher here because several orders enjoined and lawsuits active, and no documented routine street stops of visitors; lower because custody abuse and permanent-ineligibility risk are more severe.

Similar: ward/facility placement by document marker causing denial/delay rather than certain detention. Lower here because this case adds border refusal/fraud risk, criminal trespass possibility in some jurisdictions, birth-sex custody and hormone removal, and a state-wide government-facility ban.

Similar: birth-sex prison housing with assault/solitary as protection. Higher here because sentences are usually short, execution not credible for gender conduct, and functioning courts/lawyers provide more recourse than in 0.25-C; worst features are less systematic daily raids/extortion.

Higher than 0.75-C border case where mismatched passports lead to brief detention with counsel/compensation and respectful training. Here mismatch can lead to refusal, fraud consideration and custody harm, and facilities are legally barred, so materially lower.

parsed.synthesis: Exposure dominates: every visitor faces birth-sex passport, entry and government-facility checks; discovery can trigger refusal, investigation, trespass arrest or immigration/federal custody where hormone denial, solitary and reported sexual abuse are documented. Protections are real but partial: national hate-crime and employment law, courts enjoining some orders, and pending suits, with no state anti-discrimination or hate-crime cover in this state. No credible execution or routine long imprisonment for presence keeps it above 0.25-0.35, but universal state-imposed exposure without a working remedy for the upheld passport and bathroom rules keeps it at the bottom of Elevated Risk.
